ruleEvidence.level: current official hero/API and current OL client
facts: Wu, male, base HP3; current spells3215 Qiejian and3216 Nishou. No old-product variant is substituted.
Qiejian observes a player losing the final Hand card; its field discard is Equipment or Judgment, while the alternative blocks only this owner-to-recipient pair for the current round.
Nishou requires genuine Equipment-zone cards entering Discard, and uses one original entity as Lightning or schedules a swap at the same actual phase end.

ruleEvidence.level: same-product community guide, not official FAQ
facts: Qiejian includes self and all actual Hand-loss causes. A preceding refill may invalidate current-empty eligibility. Qu Huang draws first; if self is the losing role, two ordered draw-one invocations occur.
A multi-equipment loss is one opportunity; selective payment uses its first chosen equipment, otherwise actual equipment-entry order. Original suit/rank are preserved.

The exchange first holds the owner original Hand, permits last-Hand children, then holds the other original Hand and permits its children, then delivers the original sets. New child draws are not swapped.
The end of any genuine phase can settle the issued swap. Lowest-Hand ties are chosen; sole-lowest self causes no swap. Abolished Judgment and existing Lightning prevent that native use.

implementationInferences: Guide point8 is applied as branch memory: a swap branch issued in the current actual turn remains used for that turn, including after its exact phase debt settles. This is supplementary-guide interpretation, not an added numeric once-per-turn cap on the whole skill. Lightning is governed by current native legality; if the old Lightning leaves Judgment, another original-equipment Lightning may be legal.

An event with no recorded active phase can offer a legal original-equipment Lightning, but cannot create an invented phase-end swap debt. A skipped phase has no fabricated ending; the debt cannot migrate to a later phase or actual turn.

An already issued stable phase debt survives original source loss. An unstarted merely collected ordinary movement candidate retains normal live-source eligibility. Once physical costs are paid, genuine native HP/recovery/dying/death children return to that exact receipt without repaying.

Entity retrieval is limited to the exact original still-Discard equipment, with full actual native action/material/source proof. Earlier movement of that entity makes Lightning unavailable rather than obtaining or cloning another card.

On death or game completion during a paid swap, only genuine still-held original entities are discarded as cleanup; an unheld other Hand is not seized. This operational termination policy preserves card zones and follows the paid-child native death contract.

Last-Hand native Use payment is observed before its effects: an immutable native payment receipt and a scalar issued qualification retain the accepted boundary. Current-empty and unblocked/live-source eligibility are checked at issuance, while an earlier Lianying refill can still invalidate the subsequent Qiejian candidate.

Current ongoing card-identity and effective appearance queries determine native Lightning use; no optional hand ViewAs changes the original printed movement proof. Equipment-removal effects, GeneralWeapon OutsideGame routing and WoodenOx grain remain native.

runtime.pendingOwner: ProgramSkillFrame.QuHuang; one immutable receipt, exact typed native parents and returns; no parallel pending/use-ID sidecar

runtime.events: All new rule event payloads are scalar or contain only scalar immutable origin records; all exposed receipt collections defensively copy into read-only arrays.

focusedCoverageIntent.QiejianActualLastHandSelfForeignRoundAnd: Self/foreign actual Hand loss, per-pair round expiry, native earlier Lianying refill, last-Hand DrawTwo/Simple/Equipment payment before effects and cold native return.
focusedCoverageIntent.NishouOriginalLightningEquipmentOrderAnd: Atomic selected/nonselective multi-equipment and actual matching-recast peer reverse selection; exact Lightning original entity/suit/rank/once payment and abolished Judgment alternative.
focusedCoverageIntent.NishouGenuinePhaseDebtSourceLossAndTimin: Six genuine actual phase endings with exact token, paid source loss and stable debt return; no turn-end approximation.
focusedCoverageIntent.NishouStagedOriginalHandsPrivacyAndPaidC: Private original-Hand holding, two intermediate Qiejian children, child draws excluded from swaps, paid source loss/death cleanup, native SilverLion recovery and WoodenOx-grain damage children.
